key.name: desaturate-icon
key.description: Show the focused application's icon in the app menu button in grayscale.

key.name: symbolic-icon
key.description: Use the application's symbolic (monochrome) icon in the app menu button when one is available.

key.name: bold-label
key.description: Show the application name in the panel button in bold.

key.name: show-distro-when-idle
key.summary: Show distro logo and name when no app is focused
key.description: When no application is active, show the operating system's logo and name (from /etc/os-release) in the panel button instead of hiding it.

key.name: align-menu-left
key.summary: Align menu with the left edge of the button
key.description: Open the app menu so its left edge lines up with the left edge of the panel button, instead of centring it under the button.
